decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost logistics service close to the core business, though it overlaps with the broader express line D and could be folded into it.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door is an integral module of the Teckentrup 62 system with long certification cycles, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The multi-model express line for doors and gates has its own page and differentiates the firm on speed, and dropping the 72-hour program has concentrated express resources here.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic long-term investment that ties in trade partners and supports the service direction.
The fire and smoke protection door is a certified core safety product with steady demand driven by building regulations.
